cases.comparison: Compare whether each pretty format displays an independently verifiable signature and that later --no-show-signature suppresses it. Preserve full output separately to examine ordering and formatting.
cases.oracle: Pinned system Git and OpenSSH, with a system-signed fixture commit and isolated signer key.
cases.setup_script:
export GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=2 GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=gc.auto GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0=0 GIT_CONFIG_KEY_1=maintenance.auto GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_1=false
set -e
export GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null
export GIT_AUTHOR_NAME=Fixture GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL=fixture@example.test GIT_COMMITTER_NAME=Fixture GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL=fixture@example.test
export GIT_AUTHOR_DATE='2020-03-01T00:00:00Z' GIT_COMMITTER_DATE='2020-03-01T00:00:00Z'
/usr/bin/ssh-keygen -q -t ed25519 -N '' -C fixture -f "$HOME/key"
read -r kt kk kc < "$HOME/key.pub"
printf 'fixture@example.test namespaces="git" %s %s\n' "$kt" "$kk" > "$HOME/signers"
/usr/bin/git init -q -b main signed
printf 'signed\n' >signed/file
/usr/bin/git -C signed add file
/usr/bin/git -C signed -c gpg.format=ssh -c user.signingKey="$HOME/key" commit -q -S -m signed
cases.stdout:
format rc=0 signature=yes
pretty rc=0 signature=yes
oneline rc=0 signature=yes
default rc=0 signature=yes
disabled rc=0 signature=no
